note: Italian Game: Nc3 is a sound developing move (move was ~best). Dim-2 should be N/A (affirmed best). Coach gives a solid level-appropriate explanation.
coachText: Nice — Nc3 develops your last knight toward the center and keeps an eye on the d5 and e4 squares. A good rule in the opening is to get your knights and bishops out before moving the same piece twice. Next you can castle to tuck your king away safely.
